title: Version Bump
description: Stops breaking changes shipping as a minor or patch that every ^range installs automatically by reading the changes (Conventional Commits or tagged), marking the bump they need, previewing each option's version, warning when the pick is too small (or a needless major), and reading back "1.4.2 → 2.0.0" with who gets it, while handling 0.x's shifted breaking slot, pre-release tags that drop on release, and tags that sort backwards (2.0.0-beta.0 < 2.0.0-rc.1).
stops: Breaking change shipped as a minor
